KDRAGS.keybindings.bypass.name: Bypass pathfinding (hold)
KDRAGS.keybindings.bypass.hint: Hold this key while dragging to ignore pathfinding, wall collision and the movement clamp. Release it to route the drag again.
KDRAGS.settings.enabled.name: Enable drag pathfinding
KDRAGS.settings.enabled.hint: Route dragged tokens around walls while the drag is in progress. When disabled, Foundry's native drag behaviour is used.
KDRAGS.settings.enforceBudget.name: Limit movement by the actor's rate
KDRAGS.settings.enforceBudget.hint: Cut each drag at the actor's movement rate minus the movement already recorded this turn. When the rate is spent, the next drag is allowed twice the rate.
KDRAGS.settings.movementAttribute.name: Movement attribute path
KDRAGS.settings.movementAttribute.hint: Data path on the actor, for example system.attributes.movement.walk. Leave empty to detect common system paths automatically.
KDRAGS.settings.fallbackSpeed.name: Fallback movement (grid spaces)
KDRAGS.settings.fallbackSpeed.hint: Movement allowed per drag when the actor's movement rate cannot be read. Set to 0 for no budget at all.
KDRAGS.settings.footprintScale.name: Footprint scale
KDRAGS.settings.footprintScale.hint: The token is modelled as a disc of half its largest dimension times this scale. Lower it to let tokens squeeze through gaps they visually fit.
KDRAGS.settings.gridCell.name: Pathfinding grid cell (px)
KDRAGS.settings.gridCell.hint: A* cell size in pixels. Smaller is more accurate and slower; 8 px matches the original pathfinder.
KDRAGS.settings.clearancePad.name: Extra wall clearance (px)
KDRAGS.settings.clearancePad.hint: Extra clearance beyond the token footprint the route keeps. 0 lets a token use a corridor it exactly fits; 2-4 gives smoother routes but can refuse a perfect-fit gap.
KDRAGS.settings.drawBeyondBudget.name: Draw the route beyond the budget
KDRAGS.settings.drawBeyondBudget.hint: Draw the part of the path past the movement budget in blue, plus a ghost disc where the token will stop.
KDRAGS.settings.debug.name: Debug logging
KDRAGS.settings.debug.hint: Log each drag plan (path length, budget, timing) to the browser console.
